qaMethod: Native-detail visual inspection of each accepted candidate against the sole canonical original, plus read-only SHA-256, PNG dimensions, RGB<245 edge-margin, subject-fill, aspect-ratio, unique-hash and generator-source byte-equality checks. No image was altered during QA.

acceptanceRules.signatureGeometryPreserved: complete two-post square-profile outer frame; straight full top header with beveled inner opening; dark recessed full-height reveal immediately inside the far-left post; smooth flat slab; exactly one upper vertical seam near the left quarter descending into one down-left diagonal, one lower vertical seam and one horizontal branch to the right jamb; no extra panels, grooves, glass, decoration or joints
acceptanceRules.hardwarePreserved: exactly one short slim dark horizontal lever on one circular rosette at the left around 57% height, exactly one separate small dark key cylinder below, no visible hinges and no additional hardware

minimalWhiteMargin.goal: make the complete door occupy the canvas as fully as possible
minimalWhiteMargin.canonicalEdgeContactPolicy: Only top contact is source-permitted. All accepted variants retain positive margins on every edge; candidates with bottom or side contact were preserved as rejected even when the native silhouette appeared complete.
minimalWhiteMargin.documentedExceptions: negro, wengue, gris-oscuro, antracita, nogal, roble, gris-claro, natural and blanco have one or more RGB<245 readings between 7 and 12 px. All remain within the normal maximum. Extensive direct ImageGen retries were used for negro, gris-oscuro, nogal, roble and gris-claro; no crop or resize was used. Native inspection confirms complete frame moldings and a visually tight catalog composition in every accepted image.
minimalWhiteMargin.lightFinishMeasurementNote: For gris-claro and blanco, RGB<245 is conservative because the finish approaches the white background. Both were inspected at native detail and retain a complete, visible silhouette.

summary.visualInspection: PASS: all accepted finishes preserve the complete frame, dark left reveal, asymmetric vertical-diagonal-horizontal seam network, one slim lever on one circular rosette, one separate cylinder, no visible hinges and no logo or text.
